subject.title: Support Workers AI model selection during onboard

question: Should the official Cloudflare AI Gateway plugin expand from its current Anthropic-only contract to a Workers AI selectable mode during onboarding, or should Workers AI remain a documented custom-provider workflow?
rationale: This determines the official provider identity, endpoint and authentication shape, model-catalog semantics, CLI contract, and compatibility expectations shared with the broader Cloudflare provider issues.

options.title: Add plugin-owned Workers AI mode
options.body: Extend the official Cloudflare plugin with an explicit Workers AI endpoint and model mode while keeping provider-specific onboarding inside the plugin.

options.title: Document custom-provider workflow
options.body: Keep the official Cloudflare provider Anthropic-only and publish an exact supported custom-provider command and configuration path for Workers AI.

options.title: Defer to bridge redesign
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/94554 canonical and implement onboarding only after the broader multi-provider contract is settled.

recommendation.title: Add plugin-owned Workers AI mode
recommendation.body: Extend the official Cloudflare plugin with an explicit Workers AI endpoint and model mode while keeping provider-specific onboarding inside the plugin.

likelyOwner.reason: This person landed the original provider implementation and has already supplied recent review context on the remaining product choice.
